title: Sky Soprano & Northside Lord Make It “Offish”
excerpt: Straight outta Brooklyn, where every block tells a story and every move is earned, Sky Soprano connects with Queens’ own Northside Lord for their new collaborat
summary: Straight outta Brooklyn, where every block tells a story and every move is earned, Sky Soprano connects with Queens’ own Northside Lord for their new collaboration “It’s Offish.” Two boroughs, one mission — this short but potent visual captures the essence of New York Hip-Hop in its rawest form. Sky Soprano brings that Brooklyn grit while Northside Lord reps Queens with equal intensity, trading bars over a gritty backdrop that demands attention. The chemistry is undeniable, proving that when NYC’s finest link up, the results speak for themselves.

title: Cormega Celebrates 25 Years of The Realness in Los Angeles at the Regent Theater
excerpt: Cormega On Friday, July 24, legendary Queensbridge rapper Cormega brought the 25th anniversary celebration of his landmark debut album, The Realness, to Los Ang
summary: Cormega On Friday, July 24, legendary Queensbridge rapper Cormega brought the 25th anniversary celebration of his landmark debut album, The Realness , to Los Angeles. Originally released in 2001, the album remains one of the most revered independent hip-hop releases of its era, and fans packed the venue to witness a special performance honoring its legacy. Cormega performed The Realness from front to back, taking the audience on a journey through one of Queensbridge’s defining classics.

title: Rio Da Yung OG’s “The World is M.I.N.E.” Tour Touches Down at the Regent Theater
excerpt: The Regent Theater in Los Angeles is set to become the epicenter of raw, unfiltered hip-hop on August 4th as Flint, Michigan’s grittiest export, Rio Da Yung OG,
summary: The Regent Theater in Los Angeles is set to become the epicenter of raw, unfiltered hip-hop on August 4th as Flint, Michigan’s grittiest export, Rio Da Yung OG , rolls through as part of his highly anticipated “The World is M.I.N.E.” Tour. For those who’ve been locked into his wave, Rio—born Da’mario Donshay Horne-McCullough—needs no introduction. He’s the rapper who turned the mundane miseries of street life into hypnotic, off-kilter poetry, delivering bars with a deadpan stare and a darkly comedic twist that catches you off guard every single time.

excerpt: New collaborative extended play from New York recording artists NEMS & Ron Browz. One of whom is an underground veteran hailing from Coney Island, Brooklyn emer
summary: New collaborative extended play from New York recording artists NEMS & Ron Browz . One of whom is an underground veteran hailing from Coney Island, Brooklyn emerging in the battle rap circuit back in the early 2000s & the other’s a Harlem native gaining widespread recognition for producing Nas ’ iconic JAY-Z diss “Ether”. They’ve crossed paths a couple times on tracks like “The Bar Exam” & “Count It Out” prior to I Should Boom You this past spring, linking back up for a sequel 3 months later.

title: Tash Returns with New EP “Attention is a Drug”, First Solo Project in 17 Years (EP Review)
excerpt: Tash is a 54 year old MC from Columbus, Ohio who would relocate to Los Angeles, California to form Tha Alkaholiks. He would eventually drop his underappreciated
summary: Tash is a 54 year old MC from Columbus, Ohio who would relocate to Los Angeles, California to form Tha Alkaholiks . He would eventually drop his underappreciated solo debut Rap Life in the fall of 1999 under Loud Records & Columbia Records, which was followed up with the poorly received sophomore effort Control Freak a decade later. This new EP on the contrary has already been teased for some time already & the Catashtraphe has signed with Fat Beats Records to finally put it out.

title: Point 5ve Formerly Lil’ ½ Dead Makes a Stylistic Departure with “Take a Look at Me Now” (EP Review)

summary: Point 5ve formerly known as Lil’ ½ Dead is a 51 year old singer/songwriter & former rapper from Los Angeles, California who dropped his full-length debut The Dead Has Arisen & the sophomore effort Steel on a Mission under Priority Records back in the mid-90s. He returned in 2012 for his 3rd album Dead Serious to generally more mixed reception compared to his major label output & over a decade later, WWE Hall of Famer Snoop Dogg has signed him to Death Row Records distributed by gamma. to reinvent himself for a new extended play stylistically departing from the g-funk sound in favor of an R&B direction.

title: Cypress Hill Goes Full Spanish on “Dios Bendiga” (Album Review)
excerpt: South Gate, California veterans Cypress Hill going full Spanish for their 11th studio LP. Consisting of B-Real & Sen Dog on the mic as well as DJ Muggs on the b
summary: South Gate, California veterans Cypress Hill going full Spanish for their 11th studio LP. Consisting of B-Real & Sen Dog on the mic as well as DJ Muggs on the boards & Eric Bobo on percussion, the quartet would take the west coast by storm a little over 3 decades back off their eponymous debut under Ruffhouse Records in tandem with Columbia Records because of Muggs’ unique production style & their pro-marijuana legalization themes. Other standouts in the group’s discography include Black Sunday , my personal favorite Cypress Hill III: Temples of Boom , the criminally underappreciated Cypress Hill IV , Elephants on Acid & the Black Milk -produced Back in Black through MNRK Music Group.

title: Apathy Produces MC Serch’s New EP ‘Millions of Zeros”, First Solo Project in Over 3 Decades (EP Review)
excerpt: MC Serch is a 59 year old MC, songwriter & record executive from Queens, New York who rose to prominence as 1/3 of 3rd Bass. He would also drop a solo LP follow
summary: MC Serch is a 59 year old MC, songwriter & record executive from Queens, New York who rose to prominence as 1/3 of 3rd Bass. He would also drop a solo LP following their disbandment under Def Jam Recordings called Return of the Product , where Nas made one of his very 1st guest appearances. It’s been over 3 decades since then & to my surprise, he has enlisted Apathy from the Army of the Pharaohs & Demigodz collectives to fully produce a new extended play of material.
